title: Teodoro skips personal welcome for Chinese exec at Asean defense talks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. did not personally welcome China’s representative to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Defense Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, on Thursday, Oct. 29. Instead, Defense Undersecretary Ignacio Madriaga received Senior Captain Yang Lei, China’s defense attaché to the Philippines, on his behalf. Teodoro, who chairs the meeting, personally welcomed other delegates, including deputy defense ministers from Asean’s dialogue partners. READ: Hegseth in Cebu: Time for ‘ambitious’ US-Asean defense ties China sent its embassy’s defense attaché to the meeting, its lowest-ranking representative to date, according to Chinese state media.
